Red & blue light + hot/cold + vibration.
Continuous blue light with a focused, clean sensation. Ideal for shorter sessions where the goal is a crisp, refreshing experience.
Continuous red light (660nm) designed for steady exposure and a smooth, immersive session. Therapists choose this when they want a simple, reliable light experience without distraction.

HOT/COLD, RED/BLUE (36 SEC RAPID SWITCH)

Extended contrast holds that feel immersive and calming rather than rhythmic. Ideal for longer recovery sessions where stability and gradual reset are the priority.

HOT/COLD, RED/BLUE (18 SEC RAPID SWITCH)

Slower hot–cold transitions that allow the body to adapt more fully to each temperature phase. Therapists select this when they want a deeper-feeling release without abrupt changes.

HOT/COLD, RED/BLUE (36 SEC RAPID SWITCH)

Very slow cycling with extended phases that promote stability and calm immersion. Best suited for recovery-focused or longer sessions.

HOT/COLD, RED/BLUE (18 SEC RAPID SWITCH)

Slower transitions with longer holds that feel heavier and more sustained. Ideal when the goal is easing tension and encouraging deeper response.

Use Cases: Recovery following exercise or physical activity
Best For: Post-exercise, Athletes, Active adults
Why It Works: Light recovery loosens worked tissue; the cold close reduces post-exercise inflammation and settles the body into parasympathetic recovery.
